prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular fortification sprite atlas for Crazy Battle, a premium painted 2D pine-forest defense game. Transparent alpha PNG, EXACT 2 columns x 2 rows with four separate isolated assets, generous transparent margins within each equal cell. All assets same hand-painted olive green, warm tan sandbags, weathered gray concrete and earthy brown wood, warm upper-left daylight, shallow elevated side-on 3/4 camera. Top-left cell: COMPACT LOW command bunker, broad squat reinforced concrete base with one dark firing slit and small steel door, timber reinforced corners, flat olive camouflaged roof with a small timber observation cupola and thin radio antenna. ONE low compact building, not a tall watchtower or multistorey wall. No stairs, no guns, no attached sandbag platforms, no people. Top-right cell: EMPTY oval ground-level artillery emplacement: low continuous horseshoe of chunky tan sandbags and timber retaining stakes surrounding a FLAT compacted brown EARTH FLOOR. Shallow bowl planted in ground, visible interior flat pad ready for a separate cannon sprite, FRONT LOWER arc of sandbags visible. No gun, no soldier, no crates. Bottom-left cell: narrow vertical service trench segment seen from slightly above, packed dirt walking lane running TOP TO BOTTOM, rough timber retaining planks on LEFT edge, subtle olive earth berm, OPEN clean tile edges at top and bottom to join vertically, no structures, no sandbag platforms, no characters. Bottom-right cell: small supply cluster of two olive ammunition crates, a tan canvas roll and one fuel can. All sprites fully inside cells, each self contained except open ends of trench segment, no scene or environment outside assets, no UI, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no logos, no checkerboard background. True transparent pixels around each sprite, NOT a painted brown backdrop. Detailed but readable at small in-game scale. This is an asset sheet, not a concept screenshot.
